# Rule: Overload added beside an initializer_list overload

_Canonical rule slug:_ `overload-added-beside-initializer-list`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A new scalar overload joins a set that already has a std::initializer_list overload, which keeps winning braced calls, so no call becomes ambiguous.
